touches.text: A device may also own other processes besides its own. They are inside the device's boundary. Eg Cairn owns the bus process (where the shims run) and the ground loop.
A device talks to other devices only over the bus, never by importing them.
The bus is the only door, with exceptions (Akien 2026-10-22). Each is a client tool the device publishes:

Owns the inspectors and gates (draft, moving from standalone): build_inspector, plan_inspector, ticket_inspector, corrosion, exemptions, rehearsal, determinism, import_sieve, and the tester (11; Q#33, Akien 2026-10-29). (Not diagnostic_inspector: it is base's, 17.3.) The code pipeline's inspectors and gates move to CodeMother; any that are not about code (if such existed) would not. (Q#31, Akien 2026-10-27)
build_inspector: python sieves run after a build; reds a component that fails one (no charter, no proofs, a silent device, ...). "We find a new thing, we add a new sieve." → CodeMother (10.3.5)
gate: the == compare, in one place. A gate opens when every expected equals its actual. No oracle, ever.
import_sieve: one parse of every .py into an import graph; what reaches what. Enforces "only the proxy reaches the host/database" and RULE 1. → CodeMother
